summary: Tsakos Energy Navigation Ltd filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-17 carrying its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 2026-06-30, with comparatives for 2025 periods and a June 30, 2026 balance sheet. The filing is a routine non-US quarterly reporting equivalent to a US domestic issuer's Form 10-Q; it includes equity rollforward detail across common, treasury, preferred Series E and F, retained earnings, noncontrolling interests and related-party tags, plus vessel-level segment tags. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation event is disclosed, so no deal terms apply. Watch future 6-Ks for fleet sale-and-leaseback or M&A activity rather than this report.
